# llms.txt — Zuhaib Ahmed Portfolio

This file documents the LLM-related capabilities, integrations, and metadata for the Zuhaib Ahmed portfolio project. It follows the llms.txt convention for exposing project-level LLM information.

## Project Overview
- **Name:** Zuhaib Ahmed Portfolio
- **Type:** Full-stack AI engineer portfolio website
- **Primary Focus:** Agentic AI systems, multi-agent LLM pipelines, and full-stack ML products

## LLM Integrations

### Supabase Backend
- **URL:** https://bjpaassoitjcsbokvjrc.supabase.co
- **Purpose:** Bookings system with conflict detection, RLS policies
- **Tables:** `bookings` (status: held → pending_verification → confirmed)
- **Rules:** 10 PM–1 AM PKT window, 30-min slots, 14-day horizon, PKR 5,000 / ~$18 per block
- **Authentication:** anon key from `.env` (gitignored)
- **Conflict Detection:** `slot_taken` (same slot) and `overlap` (time overlap) return 409

### Resend Email Service
- **API Key:** `RESEND_API_KEY` (send-only restricted, in `.env`)
- **From Address:** `onboarding@resend.dev` (test sender — spam risk; permanent fix = verified domain)
- **From Display Name:** `Zuhaib Ahmed - Portfolio`
- **Contact Form:** POST `/api/contact` → sends inquiry email
- **Booking Emails:** `sb()` helper in `api/_bookings.mjs` sends booking confirmation via Resend

### Gemini API
- **Key:** `MY_GEMINI_API_KEY` (placeholder, empty `{}` in old credentials)
- **Status:** Old credentials purged locally via `reflog + gc`

## Design System

### Theme Engine
- **3 Preview Themes** (active on dev servers ports 5174/5175/5176):
  - **A · Minimal** (port 5174): Centered agency layout, flat square cards, indigo accent, serif Fraunces display
  - **B · Terminal** (port 5175): Left sidebar navigation, monospace typography, green/amber on near-black, boxy code-block cards
  - **C · Editorial** (port 5176): Top masthead with rules, narrow 62rem reading measure, paper-like cards, ·-separated pills
- **Theme Attribute:** `<html data-theme="minimal|terminal|editorial">` set via `%VITE_THEME%` env var or `?theme=` query param
- **Default:** Original dark glassmorphism (production untouched)

### 3D Scene
- **Engine:** `@react-three/fiber` + `@react-three/drei`
- **Particles:** 2,600 (desktop) / 1,300 (mobile) points, additive-blended, per-theme palettes
- **Floating Shapes:** Icosahedron, torus, octahedron, dodecahedron with theme-aware colors
- **Palette per Theme:** Minimal (indigo/ink), Terminal (green/amber), Editorial (burnt-orange/ink)

## Project Structure
- **Framework:** React 19 + Vite 6
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS 3.4 with `data-theme` overrides in `src/preview-themes.css`
- **3D:** `@react-three/fiber`, `@react-three/drei` (Float for floating shapes)
- **API Routes:** `api/_bookings.mjs`, `api/_contact.mjs`
- **Env:** `.env` (gitignored): `RESEND_API_KEY`, `RESEND_FROM`, `CONTACT_TO`, `SUPABASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`
- **Branch:** `design-exploration` (creation from main; remote `origin` = `https://github.com/zuibahmed7/portfolio.git`)

## Key Capabilities
- **Booking System:** End-to-end flow with Supabase conflict detection (hold 200, same-slot 409, overlap 409, confirm → pending_verification)
- **Email Sending:** Resend-backed contact + booking forms (test sender; verified domain needed for production)
- **GSC Verification:** `google8bf6934e644de159.html` (public, confirmed 200)
- **Sitemap + Robots:** Updated for live URL `https://portfolio-6wz5.vercel.app/`
- **Social Links:** Instagram, X (Twitter), Facebook (added to `content.js`, Contact/Navbar/Hero)
- **SEO:** Canonical/OG/Twitter cards → live URL; 3 JSON-LD blocks (Person, ItemList/SoftwareApplication, FAQPage); prerender post-build injection (`scripts/prerender-seo.mjs`); GSC + sitemap submitted

## LLM Tooling Notes
- **Claude/Gemini:** Project uses Gemini API (old key purged) and Supabase for data persistence
- **No OpenAI:** Project maintains own Supabase backend; no third-party LLM calls in production
- **Design Exploration:** 3-theme preview on separate Vite servers; safe refactor via CSS variables (identical output to original)

## Development
- **Preview Servers:** `npm run dev -- --port 5174 -- VITE_THEME=minimal`, etc.
- **Build:** `vite build && node scripts/prerender-seo.mjs`
- **One URL Switcher:** `http://localhost:5174/` with floating theme switcher (Original/A/Terminal/C/Editorial)
